result.instructions: Tools for Taleez, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "Which of my jobs are published right now, and how many are in each contract type?"; "Show me the pipeline steps and where candidate 4821 stands in each application."; "Find the candidate with the e-mail anna@example.com and list the talent pools she is in.". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes Taleez data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run taleez_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run taleez_request_feature to record the request. Paid plan: Pro (unlimited tool calls (fair use limit: 10,000 a month), $9/month or $90/year). Pro can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run taleez_upgrade (plan "monthly" or "yearly"); it returns a payment link for the user to open. taleez_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: taleez_list_jobs
tools.title: List jobs
tools.description: List the job postings of the company (id, label, status DRAFT/PUBLISHED/DONE/SUSPENDED, contract, location, recruiter, unit, tags, visibility, public URL). Filter by status, contract, unit, city, tag, company label or visibility; sort by creation or publication date. Job and profile descriptions are only included with with_details. GET /0/jobs.

status.description: Only jobs in one of these statuses.

contract.description: Only jobs with one of these contract types.

unit_id.description: Only jobs of these units (see taleez_list_units).

company_label.description: Only jobs with this exact company label.

visibility.description: Only jobs with these visibilities (restricted jobs need a visibility token, which these tools do not send).

sort_direction.description: Sort direction (default asc) when sort_by is set.

with_details.description: Include the job, profile and company descriptions (long HTML text). Default false.

with_props.description: Include the custom job properties. Default false.

page.description: Page number, starting at 0 (default 0). Pass the previous reply's next_page.

tools.name: taleez_get_job
tools.title: Get job
tools.description: One job posting by id with its full details: descriptions, contract, location, recruiter, unit, tags, custom properties, public and application URLs. GET /0/jobs/{id}.

tools.name: taleez_get_job_steps
tools.title: Get job pipeline steps
tools.description: The recruitment pipeline steps of a job in order (id, name, order). Use them to read where each candidate stands. GET /0/jobs/{id}/steps.

tools.name: taleez_get_job_statuses
tools.title: Get job status history
tools.description: The status history of a job: each change (date timestamp, status DRAFT/PUBLISHED/SUSPENDED/DONE). GET /0/jobs/{id}/statuses.

tools.name: taleez_get_job_questions
tools.title: Get job application questions
tools.description: The questions candidates answer when applying to a job (id, label, type, required, choices). GET /0/jobs/{id}/questions.

tools.name: taleez_get_job_filters
tools.title: Count jobs by filter
tools.description: The total number of jobs and the job counts per status, contract, city, tag and company label (only values with at least one job). A quick overview of the hiring activity. GET /0/jobs/filters.

tools.name: taleez_list_job_properties
tools.title: List job properties
tools.description: The custom job properties defined in the account (id, name, type, choices). GET /0/job-properties.

page.description: Page number, starting at 0 (default 0). Pass the previous reply's next_page.

tools.name: taleez_list_candidates
tools.title: List candidates
tools.description: List the candidates in the company (id, name, mail, phone, language, location, social links, unit, creation date). Filter by exact e-mail address to find one person. Custom properties only with with_props. Candidates contain personal data: use it only for the user's own recruiting. GET /0/candidates.

mail.description: Only candidates with one of these e-mail addresses.

with_props.description: Include all custom candidate properties. Default false.

page.description: Page number, starting at 0 (default 0). Pass the previous reply's next_page.

tools.name: taleez_get_candidate
tools.title: Get candidate
tools.description: One candidate by id: name, mail, phone, language, location, social links, unit, CV link and custom properties. GET /0/candidates/{id}.

tools.name: taleez_get_candidate_applications
tools.title: Get candidate applications
tools.description: Where a candidate stands: every application or association (type SPONTANEOUS, APPLICATION_TO_A_JOB, ASSOCIATED_TO_A_JOB...) with the job id, current pipeline step, rejected/hired dates and the step history. GET /0/candidates/{id}/applications.

tools.name: taleez_get_candidate_properties
tools.title: Get candidate properties
tools.description: The custom property values of a candidate (property id, name key, type, value or choices). GET /0/candidates/{id}/properties.

tools.name: taleez_get_candidate_pools
tools.title: Get candidate pools
tools.description: The talent pools a candidate belongs to (pool id, name, date added, referrer). GET /0/candidates/{id}/pools.

tools.name: taleez_get_candidate_documents
tools.title: Get candidate documents
tools.description: The documents attached to a candidate (CV, cover letter...): id, name, date, size and file URL. GET /0/candidates/{id}/documents.

tools.name: taleez_get_candidate_events
tools.title: Get candidate events
tools.description: The events (interviews, calls, meetings) scheduled with a candidate: subject, start/end, location, meeting URL, attendees. GET /0/candidates/{id}/events.

tools.name: taleez_list_candidate_properties
tools.title: List candidate properties
tools.description: The custom candidate properties defined in the account (id, name, type, choices, disabled). Use the ids with taleez_set_candidate_properties. GET /0/candidate-properties.

with_disabled.description: Include properties disabled in the account settings. Default false.

page.description: Page number, starting at 0 (default 0). Pass the previous reply's next_page.

tools.name: taleez_list_pools
tools.title: List talent pools
tools.description: List the talent pools of the company (id, name, dates, recruiter). GET /0/pools.

page.description: Page number, starting at 0 (default 0). Pass the previous reply's next_page.

tools.name: taleez_list_pool_candidates
tools.title: List pool candidates
tools.description: The candidates in one talent pool. Custom properties only with with_props. GET /0/pools/{id}/candidates.

with_props.description: Include all custom candidate properties. Default false.

page.description: Page number, starting at 0 (default 0). Pass the previous reply's next_page.

tools.name: taleez_list_recruiters
tools.title: List recruiters
tools.description: List the recruiters (users) of the company. Use the ids to read who owns a job or to credit a new candidate. GET /0/recruiters.

page.description: Page number, starting at 0 (default 0). Pass the previous reply's next_page.

tools.name: taleez_list_units
tools.title: List units
tools.description: List the units (entities, subsidiaries, sites) of the company. Use the ids to filter jobs. GET /0/units.

page.description: Page number, starting at 0 (default 0). Pass the previous reply's next_page.

tools.name: taleez_list_events
tools.title: List events
tools.description: List the company's calendar events (interviews, meetings): subject, start/end timestamps, location, meeting URL, job id, attendees. GET /0/events.

sort_direction.description: Sort direction (default asc) when sort_by is set.

page.description: Page number, starting at 0 (default 0). Pass the previous reply's next_page.

tools.name: taleez_create_candidate
tools.title: Create candidate
tools.description: WRITE: add a new candidate to the Taleez database (first and last name required; the e-mail, if given, must be unique in the company). Creates a record only: the candidate is not attached to a job and no e-mail is sent by this call. Not idempotent: calling twice with no mail creates two candidates. POST /0/candidates.

mail.description: E-mail address, unique in the company.

phone.description: Phone, e.g. 0611223344 or +33611223344 (Taleez ignores an invalid number).

source.description: Where the candidate comes from (Taleez default: 'API Taleez').

lang.description: Candidate language (must be activated in the account). Default FR.

recruiter_id.description: Credit this recruiter as the one who added the candidate (see taleez_list_recruiters).

unit_id.description: Unit of the candidate (only for companies that segment candidates by unit).

location.description: Place of residence; city, country, lat and lng are all required.

country.description: ISO 3166-1 two-letter country code, e.g. FR.

tools.name: taleez_update_candidate
tools.title: Update candidate
tools.description: WRITE: change a candidate's name, e-mail, phone, social links or location. The current record is read first and unchanged name, mail and phone are sent back, so only what you pass changes (Taleez' update endpoint otherwise needs first and last name). Social links and location, when given, REPLACE the existing ones (an empty social_links object removes them all). Overwrites data; no message is sent. POST /0/candidates/{id}.

mail.description: New e-mail address, unique in the company.

phone.description: Phone, e.g. 0611223344 or +33611223344 (Taleez ignores an invalid number).

social_links.description: Replaces all social links; an empty object removes them.

location.description: Replaces the location; city, country, lat and lng are all required.

country.description: ISO 3166-1 two-letter country code, e.g. FR.

tools.name: taleez_set_candidate_properties
tools.title: Set candidate properties
tools.description: WRITE: set custom property values on a candidate. For a property without choices pass value (DATE as yyyy-MM-dd); for a property with choices pass choices (choice ids, see taleez_list_candidate_properties). An empty choices list removes all selected choices unless append_choices is true. Overwrites the previous values of the listed properties. POST /0/candidates/{id}/properties.

value.description: Value for a property without choices.

choices.description: Selected choice ids for a property with choices; [] clears them.

append_choices.description: Add the choices to the current ones instead of replacing them.

tools.name: taleez_add_candidates_to_pool
tools.title: Add candidates to a pool
tools.description: WRITE: add existing candidates to a talent pool (see taleez_list_pools). Adding a candidate already in the pool is harmless. No message is sent. POST /0/pools/{id}/candidates.

tools.name: taleez_add_candidates_to_job
tools.title: Add candidates to a job
tools.description: WRITE: associate existing candidates to a job so they appear in its recruitment pipeline (the vendor's 'add candidates to a job'; this is an association made by the recruiter, not a candidate application, and this call sends no message). Pass location_id for a job with several locations. POST /0/jobs/{id}/candidates.

location_id.description: Location id, only for a job with several locations.
